people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
translations.bsb: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.
translations.kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
translations.asv: For freedom did Christ set us free: stand fast therefore, and be not entangled again in a yoke of bondage.
